_doc: Rim crawler (act2/variants.md): the tide crawler's one carapace slot, bleached: chalky and dry where it is white (the vertex wetness is low there), still wet lacquer in the black joints, and its spawn_wound wounds and eyes slower, but bright (energy 1.7) so they carry against the Rim's white sand. write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
